svg.title: Codex: a pipeline that writes, a summary that is loaded
svg.desc: Codex's memory, version 2. When a session starts, a background job picks recent past conversations that have been idle for at least 6 hours and are at most 10 days old. Phase 1 sends each one to a model, in parallel, which writes a summary of that conversation or nothing, kept in a local database. Phase 2 writes those summaries out as files and runs one consolidation agent, with no network and no approvals, which reads what changed and rewrites memory_summary.md, a file under 10,000 bytes. A new session gets that summary in its instructions, cut at 2,500 tokens; the per-conversation summaries stay on disk and the model reads one when it needs it. The model in a session writes memory only when the user asks, as a small note that the next consolidation applies.
